scientific_limitations: Exact result assumes one unrestricted closed unitary, nondegenerate fixed endpoint spectrum, a Gibbs initial state, and standard two-projective-measurement extracted work.
The four-level enhancement concerns the optimum probability of exceeding a prescribed positive work threshold, not a positive mean, a two-stroke heat engine, or experimentally constrained controls.
Absolute priority and coverage by all broader work-tail theorems are not established; independent mathematical and publication-priority audits have not been performed.
title: A spectral matching law and a four-level cooling enhancement of single-shot work extraction
